vMatrix.notes: Boost node / V Enhancement max level is 60 (maplestorywiki, verbatim: "The maximum level for Enhancements/Boost Nodes is 60."). The six Night Walker boost node cores are, exactly: (1) Quintuple Star Boost; (2) Shadow Bat Boost + Ravenous Bat Boost; (3) Dark Omen Boost + Shadow Stitch Boost; (4) Dominion Boost; (5) Lucky Seven Boost + Soundless Rush Boost; (6) Triple Throw Boost + Shadow Spark Boost + Quad Star Boost. Re-confirmed 2026-09-12 against BOTH maplestorywiki's V Enhancements table and Grandis Library's page data; the two match each other exactly. Level-20/40 breakpoint effects per maplestorywiki: Lucky Seven Boost - Crit Rate +5% at 20, Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at 40 (the only level-40 effect on the class); Shadow Spark Boost - Max Targets +1; Quintuple Star Boost - Crit Rate +5%; Dark Omen Boost - Max Targets +1; Shadow Stitch Boost - Crit Rate +5%. Soundless Rush, Shadow Bat, Ravenous Bat, Triple Throw, Quad Star and Dominion Boost have no recorded breakpoint. The final-damage-per-level column of that wiki table uses row spans and cannot be attributed to individual skills with confidence, so it is deliberately omitted rather than guessed. Grandis Library exposes a "View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes" control on this page, which is direct evidence that Night Walker's node groupings changed at v.269 - date every node claim.

That numbering is a LAYOUT INDEX, not a ranking. Grandis assigns Night Walker only two tiers - primary (cores 1-4) and other (cores 5-6) - and states in the same block "Any combination of these skills are good". No reachable source ranks the four primary cores against each other. Do not read array position as priority; read the "tier" field.

hexa.notes: The only Night Walker HEXA investment order reachable publicly is a pair of images: "HEXA Leveling Order - Fragment Limited" and "HEXA Leveling Order - Energy Limited", credited on Grandis Library to the Night Walker Discord and file-dated 2026-09-04. Both were downloaded and read as images on 2026-09-12, and every step transcribed above was checked icon-against-legend and level-against-printed-label. There is no public Night Walker class document - maplestorywiki's Guide:Class Guides index carries a "Night Walker:" heading with NO link under it (re-confirmed 2026-09-12; the next line is "Novice:" with its own link), and Grandis Library's Other Resources block for this class links only maplestorywiki, NamuWiki and the Discord. BLOCKING CAVEAT: both charts carry the subtitle "Updated for HEXA Common Core (October 2026)", a date AFTER the v.271 target patch, and both route investment through a Common Node named "HEXA Phalanx Charge" that does not exist on maplestorywiki. These charts appear to be written for a HEXA Common Core change that may not be live in GMS at v.271. Treat the ordering as PROVISIONAL and re-verify against the Discord before presenting it as current. Node names on the charts, all validated against maplestorywiki except HEXA Phalanx Charge: Skill Nodes - Silence, Stygian Command. Mastery Nodes - HEXA Quintuple Star (a "HEXA Quintuple Star [Jet Black Throwing Stars]" variant also exists on the wiki), HEXA Shadow Bat, HEXA Ravenous Bat, HEXA Dark Omen, HEXA Dominion, Abyssal Darkness. Enhancement Nodes - Shadow Spear, Greater Dark Servant / Shadow Slide, Shadow Bite, Rapid Throw (exactly Night Walker's five class-specific 5th job skills on the wiki). Common Nodes - Sol Hecate (legend notes the icon changes at levels 20 and 30), HEXA Phalanx Charge. HEXA Stats appear as Node 1 / Node 2 / Node 3 with no stat-line recommendation attached, so no Night-Walker-specific HEXA Stat line advice could be sourced. Sol Janus appears in maplestorywiki's shared HEXA skill list for the class but appears on neither chart. Only the opening steps of each chart are transcribed here; the full charts run to roughly 200 steps and remain the authoritative artifact.

innerAbility.notes: No attack-speed inner ability line appears in either preset. That is consistent with Grandis Library's own stat table, which puts Night Walker's attack speed at Stage 8 (Stage 6 base plus +2 from Agile Throwing, 2nd Job) - i.e. the class reaches its attack speed ceiling from its own kit - and with maplestorywiki's Inner Ability guide, which scopes the Attack Speed line to "many Explorer classes which do not have a Hurricane-like skill" (Night Walker is a Cygnus Knight, not an Explorer). No source states outright that the attack-speed line is therefore unnecessary FOR NIGHT WALKER, so this remains a flagged inference rather than an assertion. The cross-class framework these presets sit inside is maplestorywiki's Inner Ability guide, verbatim: "In early to mid-game, prioritize getting to the Legendary top line only. The most important stat is 20% Mesos Obtained for training, and the bossing preset only needs an optimal top-line stat... The second and third lines can be ignored." That is a general rule, not Night-Walker-specific.

gearingNotes: CRITICAL RATE: Night Walker gets +40% crit rate from its own kit - 5% base plus 35% from Critical Throw (2nd Job). Dominion (Hyper Skill active) adds +100% crit rate, but only for its 20-second window on a 120-second cooldown, so the class is crit-capped inside its burst and sits at 40% from skills outside it; the remaining ~60% for off-burst has to come from links, legion, hyper stats, inner ability and gear. Three boost nodes add crit at node level 20 (Quintuple Star Boost +5%, Shadow Stitch Boost +5%, Lucky Seven Boost +5%), and the unpicked hyper passive Quintuple Star - Critical Chance would add +10% to that skill. Sources: Grandis Library base stats table, maplestorywiki. IGNORE DEF: +44.75% from the kit, built as Dark Blessing (4th Job) +15% stacked multiplicatively with Adaptive Darkness III (+7% per stack, max +35%). Lucky Seven Boost adds Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at node level 40, though Grandis Library tiers that node lowest. Source: Grandis Library, maplestorywiki. BOSS DAMAGE: +0% from the class's own passives - Grandis Library's base stats table lists boss damage with an empty source list. Every point of boss damage is external (gear, potentials, legion, hyper stats, inner ability, and the Quintuple Star - Boss Rush hyper passive, which is boss damage on one skill only). Source: Grandis Library. ATTACK SPEED: Grandis Library lists Stage 8, from a Stage 6 base plus +2 from Agile Throwing (2nd Job). WEAPON: Claw primary, Jewel secondary, Throwing Stars as ammunition; weapon multiplier 1.75x; weapon mastery 85% (base 15% plus Throwing Expert +70%), the thief mastery cap. LUK FROM SKILLS: +80 flat (Agile Throwing +20, Physical Training +60), +1 per 2 character levels from Elemental Harmony, and +15% of assigned AP from Call of Cygnus. DARK ATTRIBUTE: every Night Walker attack is dark-attribute, including the Dark Servant / Shadow Illusion / Greater Dark Servant clones, the Shadow Bats and Ravenous Bats, and Shadow Spears; in 5th job, landing dark-attribute attacks is what builds Shadow Spear. MapleDoro describes Night Walker as the only Cygnus class with Dark Sight (used to dodge boss attacks); that claim comes from a dependent source and was not independently verified here. Final damage from skills is a point of numeric disagreement between sources - see conflicts.

sourcingCaveat: This file does NOT meet the three-independent-judgement-sources bar, and should not be shipped with the same confidence as a class that does. Night Walker has no public class document: maplestorywiki's class guide index has an empty Night Walker entry, and Grandis Library's Night Walker page carries no Class Doc link. Every current judgement claim here - boost node tiering, hyper passive build, both inner ability presets, and both HEXA leveling orders - traces to a single source family: the Night Walker Discord, presented through Grandis Library and its Discord-credited infographics. Only two independent judgement sources were reachable: that Discord family, and mystyjl's node reference, which is from 2024 and conflicts with the current node grouping. maplestorywiki is a genuine third independent source but carries facts and names only, no recommendations; it was used throughout as a name-validation allowlist, so no node or skill name in this file is unverified - with the single flagged exception of HEXA Phalanx Charge, which appears on the HEXA charts but not on the wiki. Reddit was not reachable in this environment and was not consulted; the web search budget for the session was exhausted before this pass began, so discovery ran through direct fetches and a YouTube listing rather than general search. No 2025-or-later written Night Walker guide exists outside that Discord family as far as this pass could determine. To close the gap, someone needs to read the Night Walker Discord (discord.gg/FR55ADj) directly, and to check r/Maplestory for any Night Walker HEXA discussion. RE-VERIFICATION ADDENDUM (2026-09-12): every cited page behind the five endgame sections was re-opened and every endgame claim re-checked against it. Nothing had to be deleted; the two corrections made were a data-shape fix in vMatrix and innerAbility.bossing (array order was implying rankings neither source states) and a date attribution fix on mystyjl. The sourcing picture is unchanged: still one judgement family plus one stale independent node reference, still no claim at strong consensus.
